landed_against.rule: R-17 - the slice declares its diffs here and re-captures both baselines in the same commit

why: MODULE_CC is now total over the champion slots a module emits, so 313 slots that were absent from the map state their reviewed answer instead. A reviewed 'none' writes cc_reviewed on the entry and its kind on every part the row prices, which is what the new leaves are.
No damage number moves. Every diff is a marker leaf appearing, a DamagePart repr gaining its cc_kind, the two fingerprint leaf counts, or the two Aatrox W consequences below.

Aatrox W's chain hit slows and its tether hit pulls, so the one part that repeated at the tether interval is now two parts, one landing each, at the same two instants for the same two amounts. The published event_precision of both drops from 'exact' to 'hit' because damage._evaluate_cast_parts labels a repeating part with an interval 'exact' and a single landing with an authored instant 'hit'. Nothing reads either label as coarse: the coarse-source scan keys on 'cast_boundary' alone.

timeline_coverage.control_armed_by is the new certificate: the pair engine now names which authored control event armed a control-armed holder shield, read through the same state_lifecycle.CcTriggerRule the roster walk grants Everlasting through.
